Read sample groups from an ordered label CSV

mc_labels_from_csv.Rd

Read a headerless CSV containing one sample-group label per row.

mc_labels_from_csv(path, sample_names)

Arguments

path

Filename of a comma-separated, headerless label file. The first column is read as the label vector.

sample_names

Sample-column names in the same order as the labels in the file.

Details

The file must have exactly one nonempty label for each sample. Labels are assigned by row position, not by matching sample names. Use metadata matching when sample order may differ.

Value

A character vector named by sample_names.

See also

mc_labels_from_metadata, mc_prepare

Examples

peak_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "orbi_iimn_gnps_quant.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported <- mc_prepare(
  peak_file, type = "mzmine",
  sample_keywords = c(".mzML", "Peak area")
)
label_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "Label.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported$labels <- mc_labels_from_csv(label_file, imported$sample_cols)
table(imported$labels)
#> 
#>  Blank Sample 
#>      6      3
